 "I'm more greedy to win than the series MVP."
 Park Seung-gyu (Samsung Lions), who gave precious victory to the Lion Corps with a hard hit, did not hide his greed for the championship.
 Samsung, led by head coach Park Jin-man, won 10-5 against manager Lee Kang-chul's KT Wiz in Game 4 of the 2026 KBO Korean Series (KS, best-of-seven) at Samsung Lions Park in Daegu on the 7th.
 사진 확대 Park Seung-gyu roars in Game 4 of the Korean Series. Photo = Courtesy of Samsung 사진 확대 Park Seung-gyu is hitting in Game 4 of the Korean Series. Photo = Courtesy of Samsung With this, Samsung, which made it 3-1 in the series, has only one win left for its first KS victory in 12 years since 2014 when it achieved a combined championship. They played in the fall baseball in the second place (83 wins, 3 draws and 58 losses) in the regular league, beating the third-place KIA Tigers (79 wins, 2 draws and 63 losses) in the playoff (PO, best-of-five) with 3 wins and 2 losses in the series. After that, he lost 7-8 in the first round of KS, but after winning the 2nd (3-2) and the 3rd (5-1), the victory was also heard on the day.
 It was a brilliant game for Park Seung-gyu, who started as the second batter and right fielder. He led Samsung's offense by showing off his peak hitting sense.
 Park Seung-gyu, who recorded a sacrifice bunt and a fly to right field in the bottom of the first inning, swung his bat fiercely in the bottom of the third inning when Samsung was leading 6-1. With two outs and runners on the first and third bases, he hit a fastball of 146km on three pitches by right-handed pitcher Bae Je-sung to hit shortstop and produce an RBI timely hit that flows to left field.
 Park Seung-gyu, who gained momentum, showed off his great presence in the bottom of the fifth inning when Samsung was trailing 7-4. With two outs and runners on the first and second bases, KT left-hander Oh Won-seok hit a 133km changeup on three pitches and exploded a two-run double to the left.
 It was good until the end. After one out in the bottom of the seventh inning when Samsung was taking a 9-4 lead, KT right-hander bullpen resource Sugimoto Koki hit a 140-km cutter on five pitches for a hit to the right. After that, Koo Ja-wook's RBI double came out to the left-center and scored. Thus, the final result remained three hits, three RBIs and one run from four times at bat.
 사진 확대 Park Seung-gyu, who performed very well in Game 4 of the Korean Series. Photo = Courtesy of Samsung After the game, head coach Park Jin-man said, "(Park Seung-gyu) is actively moving in the lineup, helping to connect with the center batting order," adding, "Especially, he raises the team's atmosphere with reactions." Of course, I'll start tomorrow," he said with a thumbs-up.
 Park Seung-gyu smiled brightly, saying, "Before starting the PO, my determination was to become an 'insane guy,' and I'm also happy because I'm going in a good direction."
 Regarding the hot ceremony, he said, "When we hit a hit in an important situation, we have to react more loudly to raise our atmosphere," adding, "I think we can beat the opponent with momentum only when our atmosphere comes up."
 Park Seung-gyu, who was called by Samsung as the 82nd overall in the second ninth round in 2019, is a right-handed uta outfield resource. In 396 games, he recorded a batting average of 0.255 (213 hits in 834 at-bats) with 23 home runs and 86 RBIs with an OPS (on-base plus slugging percentage) of 0.730.
 사진 확대 Park Seung-gyu roars in Game 4 of the Korean Series. Photo = Courtesy of Samsung He also had a great presence this year. He played 106 games and posted a batting average of 0.265 (84 hits in 317 at-bats) with 13 home runs, 47 RBIs and an OPS of 0.842. This year is the first time Park Seung-gyu has hit a double-digit home run in a season. Since then, he has been swinging the fire bat every day in the fall, shaking off the regret of not playing in the postseason due to an injury to his right finger last year.
 "I'm happy to go out one game at a time and I'm grateful to be here," he said, nodding, "I'm more grateful than I want to do well."
 He is also mentioned as a candidate for MVP in the series, but winning comes before that.
 Park Seung-gyu said, "I'm more greedy to win than the series MVP," adding, "I hope we win and (former) Ja-wook wins the series MVP."
